title: Costco Built The Membership Model. Amazon Ate It.
source: Costco paid household members from Costco investor filings and annual reports; Amazon Prime members from Amazon investor disclosures as compiled by CNBC, Backlinko and CapitalOneShopping coverage. Costco: 35.4M (2013), 39.3M (2015), 47.3M (2017), 53.9M (2019), 60.6M (2021), 81.0M (2025). Amazon Prime: 20M (2013), 50M (2015), 80M (2017), 120M (2019), 200M (2021), 220M (2025). Amazon Prime overtook Costco's membership base by the mid-2010s and has more than doubled it since.
